preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
The number of cities is between 2 and 2 * 10^5, inclusive.
The number of roads is between 0 and 120000, inclusive.
The city numbers and the source node are between 1 and N, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: No nodes will have a road to itself.
preconditions.description: There are no self-loops in the graph.

preconditions.expression: There will not be multiple edges between any pair of nodes.
preconditions.description: Each pair of nodes has at most one edge.

preconditions.expression: Graph is guaranteed to be sparse.
preconditions.description: The graph has a limited number of edges compared to the number of nodes.

preconditions.expression: There will be a path between any pair of nodes using the side lanes.
preconditions.description: It is guaranteed that there is a path between any pair of nodes using only village roads.

postconditions.expression: Output consists of T test case results.
postconditions.description: Each test case has a specific output format as described.

postconditions.expression: For each test case, print N-1 space-separated integers.
postconditions.description: The output for each test case should list the shortest distances from the source node to all other nodes using only village roads.

postconditions.expression: Distances are in ascending order based on vertex number.
postconditions.description: The distances should be sorted by the city number, not by the distance value.
